# The Answer Engine

> Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for Local Service Businesses

## About

The Answer Engine helps local service businesses get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and other AI platforms. Founded 2025. Based in Los Angeles, CA.

We specialize in making local businesses discoverable and recommendable by AI search engines through a data-first methodology called AEO (Answer Engine Optimization).

## Services

- Answer Authority Foundation (6-spoke content cluster + hub architecture)
- AI Citation Monitoring (monthly tracking across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews)
- YouTube Optimization for AI Citations
- Consensus Signal Building (multi-node citation network)
- Authority Retainer Services
